prohibited_actions: Email, messenger, phone or advertising contact
Live routing, pricing, discount or delivery promise
Counting fixture outcomes as GDO, PaidOrder, customer or causal uplift
authority.ratification_rule: A future canary requires one exact owner-ratified BeachheadProfile and a successor package/change record. These profiles do not grant authority.

delivery_observation.scope_limit: Executable local readiness validation only; it grants no live authority.

shared_truth_kernel.payment_truth: Only a reconciled Bank API, payment-provider or signed-bank-statement PaymentProof may become canonical payment truth. Fixture payment proof remains non-KPI.
shared_truth_kernel.fulfilment_truth: Local append-only FulfilmentLedger with primary document, human actor and evidence hash; no 1C dependency.
shared_truth_kernel.crm_role: Bitrix24 is an accepted-work projection only and is never payment truth.
shared_truth_kernel.human_authority: AI may propose claims or actions but cannot create GoldAcceptance, PermitDecision, PaymentProof, OrderRecord, Consent, Suppression or Promise.

evaluation_order_reason: Existing first-party history and explicit inbound are closest to already-held demand evidence; dealer Benchmark RFQ follows after the offer and dealer-specific capacity assumptions are owner-ratified.

global_blockers.required_input: Exactly one ratified beachhead with ICP/exclusions, region, product/system, fulfilment model, offer, SLA, risk limits and target metrics.
Exact offer and promise boundaries, including who may approve price, discount, lead time and engineering commitments.
Fresh estimator, engineering, production, delivery and installation capacity snapshot with backpressure thresholds.
Purpose and channel-specific legal basis, consent/suppression workflow, retention and deletion rules.
Bank API/payment-provider contract or signed bank statement format and verification method.
Approved Bitrix field mapping, service identity, credentials, rate limits, readback and rollback procedure after ratification.

Owner-approved lawful website/form data supply, notice and retention rules, plus an opaque form-to-Bitrix correlation contract. Raw Metrika visit/client IDs remain private and may exist only when lawful_supplied=true.
Independent review and signed evidence for the exact release, policy, config, tests, backup/restore and rollback state.

profiles.business_hypothesis: A known account with an evidenced prior commercial relationship and a current, distinct need can reach a qualified RFQ faster than a newly discovered account.
allowed_input_sources: Owner-supplied local export of prior orders, RFQs or interactions with documented lawful purpose

cohort.unit: One distinct DemandUnit per account plus object/site plus product/system scope plus time window
eligibility: Prior relationship/order/RFQ evidence is locally available and purpose-compatible.
A distinct current need or reorder/win-back trigger is represented by evidence, not merely inactivity.
Product, region and fulfilment assumptions can be evaluated from a local fixture capacity snapshot.
exclusions: Open suppression or missing legal basis for any proposed contact
Current active order that would make the new unit a duplicate
Supplier already selected with no lawful displacement path
Stale, negative or absent capacity/economics evidence
Need outside the proposed product/region/fulfilment profile
cohort.denominator_rule: Seal all eligible unique DemandUnits at cutoff before human review; do not use only accepted or contacted accounts as denominator.

trigger_examples: Explicit local RFQ or request for an updated calculation
Documented reorder/replacement requirement for a distinct object or period
Owner-provided win-back reason with current scope evidence
proof_of_intent: Usable RFQ/specification/dimensions or requested commercial calculation
Identified buying role and account/object scope
Decision horizon and next evidence/action are explicit
not_proof_of_intent: A prior payment without a current distinct need
A manager note without primary evidence
profiles.shadow_offer: Prepare a no-send calculation/readiness task for a human owner; do not quote, promise, discount or contact.

shadow_action.output: Local Company/Deal/Task-shaped projection bound to exact accepted DemandUnit, GoldAcceptance and PermitDecision.

shadow_metrics: Fixture Raw-to-Reconciliation success and replay digest
profile_specific_blockers: Owner has not defined the exact win-back/reorder offer or exclusions.
The lawful contact basis and suppression reconciliation for the existing base are not approved.
Current account/order extract and its field ownership are not supplied.
The active beachhead is not ratified.

profiles.business_hypothesis: A known dealer or installer with a concrete, comparable requirement can be evaluated through a bounded Benchmark RFQ package without treating a generic promise to respond as Gold demand.
allowed_input_sources: Owner-supplied local dealer list with documented relationship and purpose
forbidden_input_sources: New dealer scraping or directory harvesting

cohort.unit: One dealer account plus one distinct RFQ/object/product-system/time window
eligibility: Dealer/installer identity and role are human-adjudicated.
Relationship or lawful inbound/RFQ basis is documented locally.
Benchmark scope has comparable products, quantities, geography and fulfilment assumptions.
Capacity and economics can be evaluated without a live promise.
exclusions: A promise to send an RFQ later without a usable artifact
Protected opportunity owned by another channel
Unknown buyer/payer or ambiguous no-circumvention ownership
Incomparable benchmark scope or stale capacity
cohort.denominator_rule: Seal every eligible distinct dealer-RFQ unit, including rejected/incomplete units; never count dealer rows or contacts as opportunities.

trigger_examples: Usable dealer RFQ with product/system, quantity, region and requested date
Explicit request to benchmark an equivalent scoped package
Owner-supplied current project requirement tied to a known dealer
proof_of_intent: Concrete requested calculation with scope and timing
Confirmed buying role or lawful routed owner
not_proof_of_intent: Promise to send a quote/RFQ next week
Price comparison without equivalent scope and fulfilment assumptions
profiles.shadow_offer: Prepare a human-review Benchmark RFQ comparison task with scope-normalization gaps; do not send it or make price/service promises.

shadow_action.output: Local dealer Deal/Task-shaped projection with benchmark assumptions, missing evidence and exact protected-opportunity ownership.

profile_specific_blockers: Owner has not ratified the exact Benchmark RFQ offer, comparison rules or non-circumvention protocol.
Dealer cohort ownership and lawful channel basis are not supplied.
Product equivalence, margin floor and service-capacity rules are not approved.
Current PermitService fixture allowlist covers known-account history only and would require a reviewed shadow-only extension for this fixture source.

profiles.business_hypothesis: An explicit owned inbound request containing usable scope can become an accepted DemandUnit quickly when identity, capacity and safe routing are proven.
allowed_input_sources: Owner-supplied local snapshot of a lawfully received inbound request
Synthetic capacity, payment and fulfilment artifacts
forbidden_input_sources: Live website, mailbox, telephony or messenger read
Automated reply, routing or advertising retargeting

field_rules.captured_at: Required UTC Z timestamp; absent or invalid input is denied rather than invented.
field_rules.origin_channel: Captured channel field limited to WEBSITE_FORM or UNKNOWN; it is not computed by source_hierarchy.
field_rules.landing_path: Path-only value; query and fragment are stripped or rejected and never persisted in analytics.
field_rules.referrer_classification: Allowlisted class only; raw referrer URL and query are not analytics fields; missing yields UNKNOWN.
field_rules.utm: Only utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content and utm_term are allowed; missing dimensions yield UNKNOWN.
field_rules.metrika_ids: Raw visit/client IDs are private pseudonymous identifiers allowed only when lawful_supplied=true; analytics, Bitrix and evidence receive presence booleans only.
field_rules.prior_path: Path-only value with no query or fragment; missing yields UNKNOWN.
field_rules.opaque_form_correlation_id: Opaque non-PII token binds a private form/request record to the local Bitrix-shaped projection.

source_proof_exclusions: Page view or form start alone
Caller-supplied origin label without reconciled evidence
inbound_attribution_contract.local_test_observation: 6 passed; Ruff clean; not independently verified.

cohort.unit: One inbound requester/account/household plus one object/site plus product/system scope plus time window
eligibility: Inbound source and purpose are documented.
A usable request, dimensions, RFQ or calculation need is present.
Identity/role uncertainty is routed to human review rather than merged automatically.
Region/product/fulfilment feasibility can be checked from a local fixture snapshot.
exclusions: Spam, supplier solicitation, vacancy or irrelevant request
No product/system need or object/site scope
Unsafe promise, unavailable capacity or missing legal handling basis
cohort.denominator_rule: Seal all lawfully available inbound units at cutoff, including spam, duplicate, out-of-scope and rejected units with reason codes.

trigger_examples: Calculation request with dimensions/product/system and region
Request for a documented product/engineering decision tied to a concrete object
proof_of_intent: Concrete product/system need and decision horizon
Sufficient identity or an explicit human identity-review outcome
not_proof_of_intent: Page view, click or form start
Generic callback request without need evidence
A model score without source artifact
profiles.shadow_offer: Prepare a no-send triage/calculation task with missing fields and safe routing recommendation; do not reply or promise service.

shadow_action.output: Local Deal/Task-shaped projection only for an exact accepted DemandUnit, with no message or live route.

shadow_metrics: Inbound units by explicit intent artifact type
Human identity and Gold review time
profile_specific_blockers: Owner has not ratified the exact inbound product/region/fulfilment beachhead or response SLA.
Live inbound access, consent notice, retention and suppression handling are not approved.
No owner-approved live attribution capture or opaque form-to-Bitrix correlation contract exists.
Capacity/backpressure owner and safe overflow behavior are not defined.
Current PermitService fixture allowlist covers known-account history only and would require a reviewed shadow-only extension for this fixture source.

owner_decisions_required_before_any_live: Choose and ratify exactly one of the three profiles as the first beachhead.
Approve the exact offer, promise limits, region/product/fulfilment scope and exclusions.
Approve capacity/economics snapshots and backpressure thresholds.
Approve legal basis, consent/suppression and retention for each intended channel.
Approve the website/form attribution boundary: lawful data supply, private raw Metrika handling, path/referrer minimisation and opaque form-to-Bitrix correlation.
Select the payment-truth integration: Bank API, payment provider or signed bank statement format.
Provide Bitrix mapping/credentials only after the previous gates pass.
